global_study.scope: Omdia global video objects, not creators or each niche

rules: Use the same population selection, topic inclusion predicate, geography, language and measured window.
Distinguish public view events from authorized owner-only estimated minutes watched.
Include zero-view items and missing/deleted/reuploaded video objects in denominator accounting.
Video concentration is not a creator-income distribution or unique-person population.
A public API search relevance-ranked sample is not a niche census.
Omdia global watch-time concentration cannot be attributed to an individual niche.
